title: iPhone free for 1 h 31 min while 1 job waits

messages.text:
The iPhone has had no holder for 1 h 31 min (since 10:33Z; the lease of fix-scrollcb-g0 ran out). The limit is 5 min.
Waiting on the status board: worst-cases-capture (owner cap-worst; its wait names the phone).
What unblocks it: the next of cap-worst takes it (node tools/lock.mjs acquire iphone --owner <you> ...).
No steward on duty (mgmt-devices is parked): the lead handles this thread (I-175).
One message per idle period; this thread closes by itself when the slot is taken (tools/idle.mjs, I-105).
